type: 캐릭터 없는 스플래시 배경 및 효과
composition: 깊이 있는 전장 후경, 중앙 배치 공간, 가까운 칼날과 앞뒤로 휘는 검붉은 오오라. 불규칙 외곽 바깥 투명.
prompt:
TEST 6 — BLADE RAIN OVER A DESOLATE BATTLEFIELD, BLACK-CRIMSON AURA. Create ONE refined ANIME GAME SPLASH ART background and effects, with NO character drawn. The empty central standing position is for a character to be added later. Use image 1 only for clean sharp anime rendering, tangible perspective, controlled reflective materials, and effects passing in front of/behind a central subject. Image 2 is only for the sharply shaped irregular scenic silhouette, atmospheric layering and depth. Do not copy either reference's characters, identities, colors, birds, water or scene.

USER'S SPECIFICATION:
Give the background and effects a clear FRONT / MIDDLE / BACK spatial relationship.
Render the major subjects with readable perspective and THICKNESS.
Effects begin behind the central staging position, wrap around the sides, and continue into the foreground; their width and scale change with distance.
Use crisp color planes with selective curved-form shading, reflections and translucent layers.
Maintain large readable shapes and clean contours; concentrate gloss and emission in important places.
Blades pour diagonally FROM ELEVEN O'CLOCK TOWARD FIVE O'CLOCK.
Battlefield weapons are embedded in desolate earth.
Battlefield smoke.
A BLACK AND DARK CRIMSON AURA RISES from the feet area.

COMPOSITION:
A strong top-left to bottom-right diagonal blade shower sweeps around an open central standing zone. The stormy battlefield behind it forms a broad irregular jagged silhouette, like a torn oblique war-banner mass made of smoke, scenery and sharp broken planes, not a literal banner or rectangular landscape. Inside that silhouette there must be actual deep battlefield scenery: ash-gray cloud ceiling, low ruined ridgelines and distant fields of abandoned weapons fading into smoke. External negative space remains transparent. Fill the scenic mass with atmosphere, not just an empty frame around floating props.

BLADE RAIN:
Several distinct steel blades, with two or three large close blades and smaller distant ones, fall FORCEFULLY from upper-left (11 o'clock) toward lower-right (5 o'clock). ALL principal blade tips clearly point down-right. Use strong foreshortening, consistent directional momentum, sharply drawn bevels, visible metal thickness, broad cool-gray reflection planes and narrow white edge highlights. Crisp silhouettes, restrained short directional streaks. Some blades disappear into the rear smoke; medium ones pass behind the empty center; the nearest blade crosses in FRONT of a side of the aura and extends beyond the background silhouette into the transparent foreground. Keep the middle character-placement area readable rather than filling it with metal. Do not arrange blades as a radial halo or make them fly up-left. Blades are physical steel, not flat white light strips.

BATTLEFIELD:
A fractured, scorched, uneven earth platform with receding perspective, loose dark stones, a few broken shields and many sparse swords/spearheads stuck into the ground at varied angles. Distinguish these STATIONARY EMBEDDED weapons from the diagonal FALLING blades. Foreground ground edge has tangible irregular thickness. Midground contains several readable half-buried weapons; far silhouettes recede in scale and contrast. No bodies, gore, soldiers or human figures. Ground has ash, cracks and rubble, not lava or bright fire.

BATTLEFIELD SMOKE:
Layered ash-gray and muted charcoal smoke rises in different distance planes, with darker nearby wisps and softer desaturated rear banks. Smoke binds the scenery together and makes the space deep, without obscuring the sharp falling blades. Quiet smoky light behind center separates the dark aura.

BLACK-CRIMSON AURA FROM BELOW:
At the central empty feet position, around the lower-middle ground, a low black-red energy source sends several broad, controlled, tapering aura tongues UPWARD. Dense ink-black/dark-maroon interiors, rich crimson edges, a few bright red filaments only at concentrated points. Aura rises behind the center, curves around its left and right sides, and one closer curling tendril swings toward the foreground. The largest nearby arc has thickness and translucent outer layers, and occludes part of a rock or one embedded weapon. Do not paint a humanoid-shaped void or actual feet; keep a natural open volume where a future character will stand. Aura is mystical flowing energy, not a giant tree, solid tentacle, ordinary orange fire or a flat floor decal. It must read clearly as its own EFFECT LAYER in front of the dull battlefield background, separately from gray smoke and from the blade shower. Sparse red embers support the direction but do not become visual noise.

STYLE / LIGHT:
High-quality drawn 2D anime splash art, fine disciplined lines, confident clean contours, broad clear cel-shadow planes, selective gradients in smoke and aura only. Metal has coherent hard specular edges and face planes; soil/rocks matte; aura luminous selectively. Clean shapes take priority over microtexture. Restrained cool iron/slate/ash palette contrasted with dark crimson and black aura. Strong depth through scale, occlusion, perspective and contrast. No photo realism, rough oil painting, 3D render, uniform glow or opaque fog over the whole frame.

OUTPUT:
Square canvas. Whole shaped composition occupies no more than 80 percent of canvas width and height so all blade tips, smoke peaks, aura arcs and ground fragments fit with generous TRANSPARENT padding on ALL sides. Do not clip the falling blades. Actual transparent background OUTSIDE the irregular scene silhouette, painted battlefield INSIDE. ONE finished integrated scene, no character, face, animal, labels, text, logos, UI, borders, separate panels or collage sheet.
